findings_and_questions.status: Previously assessed /root/hair_ops current conditional candidate, independently reconnected in this role; no new count
findings_and_questions.observation: The reducer preflights requested inn cost, then clips through injury/disease and settlement work and charges inn_stay_cost(elapsed); the web summary independently computes and labels full-board payment using requested_minutes. If a successful stay is clipped across a billing-day threshold, the displayed full-board charge can exceed the actual inn charge.
findings_and_questions.qualification: A supported clip and successful outcome are conditions; no actual execution, observed discrepancy, downstream transaction semantics or elapsed scenario is asserted. This is exactly the earlier conditional finding in prior/web-residence-report and central reconciliation, not a new P16 finding.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: After audit and explicit later implementation authorization, trace and present authoritative committed elapsed/payment evidence, preserving interrupted stays, actual zero/no-charge and user-safe errors.

findings_and_questions.status: Previously assessed /root/hair_ops current conditional authority/presentation question; no new count
findings_and_questions.observation: Handler resolves URL settlement and checks its service, but reducer receives actor, duration and service only and checks actor actual settlement/residence. Result and local reputation use URL identity. If those settlements differ and each relevant native and URL requirement succeeds, committed location and presented location may differ.
findings_and_questions.qualification: No stale route, direct request, wrong result or unauthorized write was observed; native actor authority and actual-location checks remain safeguards. Normal UI reachability and exact aliases with q2254 are open.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: After audit and authorization, decide and enforce a single intended action-location binding and present committed location consistently, preserving native authorization.

nonfindings: The native HTTP form strings are boundary grammar; public service kinds are mapped from a typed enum and location selectors. No private classifier or fallback defect follows merely from matching text.

The direct parser checks HH:MM minute digits/range, checked multiplication/addition and hour-mode requested wake equality. Its saturating day conversion is followed by bounded duration rejection for public settlement/travel callers; blank optional requested minutes is a legitimate absent mode.
Settlement minimum is one day; field/travel minimum is one minute. Empty shelter default is rejected by the shelter parser, not silently converted to bivouac.

In selected native source, actor authorization and current-settlement service/residence checks run before rest_for_minutes; URL mismatch does not by itself prove arbitrary location mutation or broken authorization.

Reducer errors in the settlement route are logged and mapped to a generic user-facing message. The generic message is an intentional final native boundary in this scope, not automatic obligation to expose private text.
Source includes test functions as text only; no tests, fixtures or product code executed. Rest preview was registered but not displayed in this pass.

Do all source producers of form minutes, optional wake and shelter obey the intended boundary semantics and route-specific minimum, including uninspected APIs?
What are native transaction, chronology and environmental prerequisites beyond the selected slices? No client, database, UI, browser or runtime behavior was validated.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Native form -> parsed minute result -> typed venue -> authoritative reducer and separately reconstructed summary; retained requested vs actual elapsed and URL vs actor location remain conditional earlier findings.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: RestDurationError owns lexical rejection, StrategicMinute and calendar own temporal meanings, SettlementActionService owns public service. u64 minute values and native JSON are bounded ports, not proof each must become a blanket wrapper.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Hour parser checks format/range and overflow; days saturate then callers reject above max. Native actor/current-location and venue checks provide independent authoritative safeguards.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Requested and elapsed are distinct after injury/disease clipping; rounded day charge is monotone but displayed request charge can differ on interruption. No actual clipping or monetary state was observed.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Before/after time, skills, limb, inventory and reputation observations must be complete before asserting complete outcome; current aggregation may use zero/empty for absent observations under identified conditional paths.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: Backend owns actual action authority, location and elapsed; web owns input grammar and presentation. Whether to bind route URL to actor current location is the open coordination contract.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Independent requested amount and committed elapsed have different purposes; the earlier issue is their use as the same paid outcome, not two numeric variables alone. No generic duplicate clock claim.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Keep legitimate empty optional wake, one-minute travel versus one-day settlement bounds, noon/day rounding policy, residence vs public service and safe errors; no compatibility shim, reset or invalid input preservation.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: RestServiceKind separates Inn, Temple and Residence; optional SettlementActionService None is intentional for residence. Distinct typed RestDurationError reasons own rejection.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Native serde deserializes raw HTTP form fields through purpose-specific optional parser; conversion to typed minutes and service must be retained, not erased by blanket derivation.
thirteen_lenses.granularity: Differentiate wake input, requested duration, elapsed time, full-board charge, net currency and individual observation completeness; typed values alone do not certify their aggregate.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: Unit/shelter tags are external HTTP/SATS grammar and safe errors are presentation. Typed native venue classification is retained; exact UI parse/DB versions remain separate.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: 60-minute HH:MM constraint and per-day/year bounds reflect calendar grammar. Signed, zero and minimum semantics differ by duration mode; no arbitrary global range or hidden rest penalty proposed.
